// NEGATIVE fixture — `?.` only where a lexer must not see it. The gate must report nothing.
// A line comment: record?.profile
/* A block comment: record?.profile */
const SINGLE = 'record?.profile';
const DOUBLE = "record?.profile";
const TEMPLATE = `guard by hand, never record?.profile`;
const IN_REGEX = /\?\.[a-zA-Z_$]/;

export function mentionsOptionalChain(source) {
  // Regex in expression position after `return` — the shape that used to desync the stripper.
  return /record\?\.profile/.test(source);
}

export function nameOf(record) {
  const profile = record && record.profile;
  return profile ? profile.name : null;
}

export { SINGLE, DOUBLE, TEMPLATE, IN_REGEX };
